placements.title: Rollback capability requires continuous operational rehearsal
placements.frame: How do recurring rehearsals guarantee operational rollback capabilities and deployment safety?
placements.why: Quinton mandates a recurring monthly rehearsal cadence for Atlas under the foundational principle that unverified and unrehearsed rollback procedures offer no actual operational safety.

mints.name: ReliabilityResilience
mints.title: Reliability and resilience
mints.why: Groups operational practices, drill cadences, and failure-mode mitigations that verify recovery readiness.

connections.why: Articulates the overarching principle that resilience and rollback safety require active rehearsal.
Establishes concrete recurring rehearsal cadences and executive ownership for operational rollback validation.
